setup: near-world-voice-mock (offline game, mock voice), browser pane 1280x720, dpr 1, RTX 3050. 30 characters: 6 merchants + 24 townsfolk. Sim stepped at 1/60 s via __v2.game.step; probe script in the session (not committed).

probe_definitions.teleport: visible townsperson moves > 0.25 m in one 1/60 s frame
probe_definitions.yaw_snap: townsperson turns faster than 6 rad/s in one frame
probe_definitions.overlap: two visible people closer than 0.4 m, not sharing a seat/chat spot (sampled every 0.5 s)
probe_definitions.stuck: walking but under 0.08 m/s for 2.5 s

before.teleport_causes: standing up from bench/cafe seats and leaving shop doors: the wall push-out snapped them 0.5-7.1 m out of the seat or terrace collider

after.note: Before the wall-aware sidestep fix, 1 stuck walker per 90 s (pinned between a seated person and the amphitheatre tier at -15.5,-85.7).

grounding_after.method: lowest toe/foot bone minus visible pavement height, 20 samples per standing/walking character
grounding_after.note: toe bone sits a few cm above the sole; far (coarse) townsfolk match merchants measured every frame

errand_scripted.condition: SCRIPTED: market.life.errand(0, 'pema', '... (scripted test)', true) called by hand; offline there are no resident receipts
errand_scripted.result: Lin left orchard crate work, walked ~70 m to Pema carrying the crate (68 s), Pema turned to her (serving + attend), crate handed over 1.5 s after arrival, Lin resumed her day

conversation.condition: real keyboard: F at Pema's stall, 1 to continue; Tomas via play.interact()
conversation.result: listening true from the first frame, facing error 0.00-0.01 rad; Tomas waved (Wave clip, 3.3 s) on opening; talking flag not observed because the browser pane was hidden (audio playback does not start in a background tab)

performance_ms.note: CPU timings from performance.now around game.step and character.update; render = __v2.frameTime (gl.finish bracketed). Single machine, noisy within about 0.3 ms.
